Name: TC_AUTH_Login_004(Positive):  Verify sucessfull login with valid admin credentials.
Precondition:
PRE-CONDITIONS
1. Stable internet connection
2. Use one of the following environments:
- Windows 11 / Google Chrome v149 / 1920x1080 / v5.8
- Linux 7.0 / Google Chrome v149 / 1920x1080 / v5.8
3. Navigate to URL: https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com
Objective:
This test verifies that a registerd administrator user can sucessfully
authenticate and access the OrangeHRM system using a valid username and
password credentials. The test ensures proper redirection to the dashboard
and an admin session creation.
Step: Insert the username in the "Username" field
Expected Result:
1. The "Username" placeholder disappears
2. Appear the username (Admin)
